statement: The Ridge GRWT100 model scored all 904 candidate lines (E1) and its top-20 was enriched for high measured grain weight: 16/20 measured >=3.3 g/100 grains, 8/20 >=3.6 g, measured range 2.8-5.0 g. H_ENRICH is supported; E1 ranking is useful as a screening prior.
limits: Only 20/904 lines were queried; the pool 75th-percentile cutoff was never observed; no low-ranked controls were phenotyped, so enrichment is inferred from the measured level of the screened set rather than a formal high-vs-low contrast. Model-card held-out Spearman 0.454.

statement: Within the screened top-20, E1 ordering is imprecise: Spearman(predicted, measured) = 0.386 (n=20, rank-difference, no tie correction). Individual lines disagree strongly (E1-rank 1 = 5.0 g, E1-rank 8 = 3.1 g, E1-rank 13 = 2.9 g, E1-rank 14 = 4.7 g). Therefore final ordering uses measured E3 values, not E1 predictions. An earlier statement of ~0.1 in ev-2 is superseded by ev-4.
limits: n=20, range-restricted subset; rho approximate because measured values are tied/rounded to 0.1 g; not an estimate of pool-wide accuracy.

statement: Final ranked top-10 by measured GRWT100 (tie at 3.4 g broken by higher E1 prediction): IRIS_313.12254 (5.0), IRIS_313.12349 (4.7), IRIS_313.12344 (4.6), IRIS_313.12242 (4.5), IRIS_313.12228 (3.8), IRIS_313.12129 (3.8), IRIS_313.11094 (3.6), IRIS_313.10679 (3.6), IRIS_313.12262 (3.4), IRIS_313.10653 (3.4). IRIS_313.10660 (3.4) was excluded by the declared tie-break.
limits: Selection is conditioned on the 20 queried lines; unmeasured candidates (884) have E1 predictions only, so a true high-quartile line ranked lower by the model could be missed. The 3.4 g selections are borderline if the pool cutoff exceeds 3.4 g. Single environment; linear additive model ignores GxE, epistasis and dominance; applies to GRWT100 only and to lines in the reference panel. E1 predictions are not measurements.
